briefdescription.para: Dequeue the next pending send selected by priority + fair-queuing.

detaileddescription.para: Dequeue For Send.
Selects the highest-priority non-empty queue. Within a priority level, connections are served in round-robin order (fair queuing).
A starvation guard ensures that lower-priority items are occasionally served even when higher-priority queues are always non-empty (see Config::starvation_guard_threshold).

The next PendingSend, or std::nullopt if all queues are empty.
Return value.
Calls: lock(), empty(), front(), pop_front().

briefdescription.para: Network QoS Manager.

detaileddescription.para:
Provides:
Per-connection token bucket bandwidth limiting
Four-level priority queue for outbound scheduling
Fair-queuing across connections at the same priority
Backpressure signalling (write-queue depth limit)
Runtime reconfiguration (rate / burst / priority)
Statistics per connection and per priority class
